newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Fed Midwest manuf index at record in April.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Fed Midwest manuf index at record in April.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago said on Wednesday that its Midwest manufacturing index rose 0.3 percent in April to a record high level.
The Chicago Fed's Midwest index rose to a reading of 121.4 in April from 121.1 in March. The index was made available in New York.

"The auto sector fell 1.5 percent in April, due primarily to the strike at Chrysler 's Mound Road engine plant in Detroit," the Chicago Fed said. "The region's steel sector outperformed the nation's steel sector in April.
